sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you or an allied creature within range would take damage.
sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Wind Release, Barrier

system.description:
You quickly materialize a shield of Ice protecting yourself or an allied creature within range. The shield of ice has 1d10+ 10 hit points.

If this jutsu is cast while occupying an Ice Mirror, this barrier can gain the DR, resistances, immunities and vulnerabilities of your Ice Mirrors.

If the triggering damage doesn’t destroy the shield, at the beginning of your next turn, the shield of ice hardens into a structure of ice that lasts for 1 minute. This new structure can be used as an Ice Mirror.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the shields hit points by 1d10.
